port.description: MongoDB server port number. Defaults to 27017.

tls_ca_cert.description: Path to a custom CA certificate to use for verifying the MongoDB server's certificate.

tls_ca_cert_data.description: Inline PEM content of a custom CA certificate, as an alternative to providing a path.

tls_client_cert.description: Path to a client certificate and key in PEM format for mTLS authentication to the MongoDB server.

tls_client_cert_data.description: Inline PEM content of a client certificate for mTLS authentication, as an alternative to providing a path.

tls_client_key_data.description: Inline PEM content of a client key for mTLS authentication, as an alternative to providing a path.

auth_mechanism.description: Authentication mechanism to use with the MongoDB server, such as SCRAM-SHA-256 or MONGODB-X509.
